record.body:
## Evidence

Rerun of the acceptance sequence at e4484c4: non-tmux 297 passed, tmux 1 failed / 9 passed. 18 later runs were clean. The output of the failing run was not kept.

## Consequence

Acceptance checks that end in the tmux run can fail without a product defect, about 5% of the time.

## Follow-up

Run tmux checks with -rf so the next failure is named, then fix the race in that test.

payload.basis: Parent reruns on fix/dashboard-bugfix: 1 failed of 10 right after the xdist run, then 18 clean runs (15 full tmux runs, 3 full sequences); the extended popup test passed 12/12 alone
payload.claim: One tmux integration test fails rarely: 1 of 19 serial tmux runs on e4484c4, test name not captured
payload.invalidated_when: A tmux failure is captured with -rf and fixed, or 50 consecutive clean runs
